text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This original research article focuses on land use change (LUC) prediction for the entire country of Italy, explicitly implementing a spatially explicit model (a modified CLUE-S model named LUC@CMCC) at a national scale with 500 m resolution. It uses an ensemble forecasting approach combining multiple future scenarios reflecting different climate projections, demographic increases, protected area policies, and model configurations—thus implementing ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison. The study reports quantitative accuracy assessments (e.g., ROC AUC = 0.86) and provides mapped LUC projections and hotspot analyses at multiple spatial scales (administrative, biogeographical, physiographic, watershed). The primary objective is clearly LUC prediction and simulation. The paper is not a review, does not focus on species/ecology unrelated to LUC, and is not purely methodological or qualitative. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
